# Why are Muffin Tins in the Shop? (VIDEO)


#### Description


Keeping track of small parts during a job can be tricky, but there’s a cheap and effective way to solve that problem. Old muffin tins are perfect for storing and labeling auto parts. (Just don’t mix up your “shop” muffin tin with the one in your kitchen!)
